subject: Re: Kickoff: dense entity retrieval for the knowledge assistant
body:
Status as of this morning: baseline is reproduced. Rafael's dual-encoder runs land at recall@1 of 86.4 on our regenerated Wikinews set, against 87.1 published, so we are inside the 2-point envelope Anders set.

Two things to watch. First, parse_wikinews.py needed patching for template changes in the wikitext, so our eval set differs from the paper's by roughly 3% of mentions -- Tereza is auditing a sample to confirm it is not biased toward easy entities. Second, hard-negative mining is the biggest lever we have left before the June 12 review; it needs about a week of dedicated GPU time on Titan and the pool has been congested afternoons.

Risk if congestion holds: June 12 shows baseline-only numbers.

Vera
